description:
Because of his fierce appearance, Kang Woo-Hyun has never had a girlfriend, let alone a proper friend. He confesses his crush to his club senior Chae Ji-Oh while drunk. Was it the aftereffects of the confession? After dreaming of a sweet night with senior Ji-Oh, he wakes up feeling good to find "Choi Ji-Ho" next to him instead of senior Ji-Oh?! Woo-Hyun thinks this is a dream, but Ji-Ho's one word shatters Woo-Hyun's hopes.

 *"You're the one who forced me to bed and touched me, right?"*

Will Woo-Hyun be able to safely break up with his club senior Ji-Ho, who has a foul personality? A campus romance between a prickly handsome guy and a goldfish-like potato embroidery!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)
